### context: full
COMPOSITES COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  process: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  fibrePricePerKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  resinPricePerKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  partWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  fibreWeightFraction: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  wasteFraction: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  plies: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  areaM2=0.061  [1220 cm² measured surface, halved — plies cover the mould side only — deterministic, use verbatim]
  layupTimeHrPerPart: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  cureTimeHr: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  toolingCostGBP: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
  toolingLife: UNDECIDED — needs "Which fibre and resin system?" (Carbon prepreg, autoclave | Glass prepreg, oven cure | Dry glass + epoxy infusion | Dry glass + vinyl ester RTM)
